hero.title: Every hour you play, tracked for you
hero.lead: GameTrace watches your Discord status and logs your sessions on its own. No timers, no spreadsheets. Just open the web or the app and see where your time went.

autoDetect.title: Auto-Detect
autoDetect.body: The bot captures real-time activity from Discord Rich Presence. Launch a game on PC and sessions log automatically — no timers or manual clicks.

voice.title: Voice Session
voice.body: Playing offline or without Discord? Speak a single sentence or log duration manually. The model matches the title and stores the transcription directly in your note.

library.title: Game Library
library.body: Deep IGDB integration with official cover art, genres, studios, and release dates. Merge duplicates, manage your collection, and keep your history in one place.

heatmap.title: Activity Map
heatmap.body: GitHub-style interactive activity map. Track day streaks, record sessions, and weekly play patterns — without filling out spreadsheets.

trends.title: Streaks and trends
trends.body: Your current streak, records, and week-over-week trend. You know whether you're playing more or less.

rankings.title: Breakdowns and rankings
rankings.body: Game ranking, genres, themes, studios, and release decades. Analysis from every angle.

autoDetect.footnote: Playtime is logged to your account when the game closes

voice.footnote: Transcription is automatically saved into the session note

server.title: Add the bot to Discord
server.body: Invite the bot to your server or join a server where GameTrace is already running.

login.title: Connect your account
login.body: Log in with Discord in one click or generate a one-time code using the /login command in a channel.

client.title: Explore your stats
client.body: Open the web dashboard or download the Android APK. Your sessions and playtime stay in sync in real time.

bot.label: BOT
bot.body: A background service on your Discord server. Detects playtime via Rich Presence and logs sessions without manual tracking.

app.label: APP
app.body: A handy companion in your pocket. Quick view of recent sessions, voice logging, and library access on the go.
app.point3: Game library and trash on your phone

web.label: BROWSER
web.body: Full analytics hub on a large screen. Interactive activity map, advanced charts, trends, and library management.
web.point2: Catalog with IGDB metadata and covers

onboarding.title: Set up GameTrace
onboarding.subtitle: 3 short steps — it only takes a moment.

step1.title: Invite the bot or join a server
step1.bodyBoth: GameTrace runs on Discord. Invite the bot to your server or join a public server with the bot — both paths work the same.
step1.bodyServerOnly: GameTrace runs on Discord. Join a public server with the bot, or use a server that already has it.
step1.bodyBotOnly: GameTrace runs on Discord. Invite the bot to your server or join a server that already has it.
step1.joinServer: JOIN A SERVER WITH THE BOT
step1.hintServer: Once you've joined the server, come back here and click next.
step1.hintBot: Once you've added the bot to your server, come back here and click next.

step2.title: Introduce yourself to the bot
step2.body: In a server channel, send the command below. The bot will reply with a login code — don't message in a DM.
step2.hintSelected: Selected — press Ctrl+C / Cmd+C if it didn't copy automatically.
step2.hintIdle: Click the field to select the /login command.
step2.chooseTitle: How do you want to create the account
step2.chooseBody: A channel code, or Discord login. Either way the bot has to share a server with you.

step3.title: Choose a client
step3.body: One account — the same sessions in the browser and in the app.
step3.webBody: Sessions, library, and stats on a big screen — the same dashboard as in the app.
step3.appBody: Sessions, library, and stats in your pocket — the same dashboard as in the browser.

onboarding.footerLogin: Already have an account → Log in
